pointers.claim: The page explicitly addresses agents, but its biggest message gap is making “my agent captures and reads a web page” the primary action instead of asking the human to upload.
The blanket “No account needed” promise conflicts with the landing form’s account requirement for URL capture, making that path incompatible with a signup-free capture trial as currently implemented.

Before launch, the page needs a primary trial instruction and review-recipe link because its displayed terminal instruction installs Claude MCP with an API key rather than demonstrating the promised capture-and-read outcome.

Replace the hero’s dependency on Claude Code’s alleged screenshot limitation with a direct capture-and-read benefit, since the page’s own feature descriptions support that benefit without establishing the competitor limitation.

“End-to-end encrypted” needs substantiation or removal before launch because the captured page asserts it alongside content analysis and capability-link sharing without explaining the encryption boundary.

The captured consent prompt introduces a visible decision before continuation on both viewports, so the landing experience should not be presented as literally zero-click without qualifying that promise.
Pricing is discoverable, but the hero’s “See how to scale” label obscures its destination, so rename it “Pricing” and distinguish anonymous-trial limits from account benefits beside the trial CTA.
Mobile repeats the agent messaging and account requirement, but the pack provides NO-SIGNAL on terminal-command readability, making mobile copy-and-run verification necessary before launch.
